# Until January 15: preservation discount cards now available for $29k


### Reach out to us at hello@nectome.com to discuss


[Nectome](https://substack.com/@nectome)


Nov 02, 2026


As a special deal, Nectome is currently offering cumulative discount cards for a one-time payment of $29k. Discount cards can be used for anyone eligible, and don’t need a chosen recipient at the time of purchase.


If you buy a cumulative discount card today and hold it for ten years, it’s good for a free preservation, for yourself or a loved one. If you need to use it sooner than that, you’ll receive a discount on the full price of a preservation, corresponding to how long you’ve held it.


# Full-price sales at $250k


The full price for Nectome’s preservation services is $250k. This cost covers the preservation surgery and materials, long-term storage, and (once it becomes available) revival. It does not include transportation, nursing care, funeral expenses, or the end-of-life medication itself.


# How to buy


Nectome has a very straightforward “buy a preservation, get a preservation” model. We don’t do memberships, insurance, or lots of red tape. You sign one document, you send us money, and you’re entitled to one preservation.


**You can use it for yourself or a loved one, and you don’t need to decide at the time of purchase.** If the person you had in mind ends up not being eligible, use it for someone else.


We’re selling a maximum of


**100** of these cards during this sale - once they’re gone, they’re gone.


#### Reach out to us at


hello@nectome.com to discuss purchasing for yourself or a loved one.


Thanks for reading Nectome's Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
